Bill history/sponsor list names Payne as a co-sponsor of HB2853.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New section 15-2401.01 makes any K-12-eligible Arizona student also ESA-eligible, removing the prior categorical limits.

rows.reasoning: As a State Representative, Payne co-sponsored HB 2853 (2022) and voted Y on its House Third Reading; the single-subject bill's new section 15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any resident eligible to enroll in a public preschool-for-disabilities, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve program, removing the prior income, disability, and school-rating gates. This matches rung 5, 'Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school... chosen by the family.' Under the earlier-chamber ruling, this House-era record counts for his current Senate seat in the same legislature.
